newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade slightly higher, Unibanka up.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade slightly higher, Unibanka up.

text.p: Shares on the Latvian bourse edged up on Wednesday after yesterday's dull day and leading bank Unibanka also regained some ground, dealers said.
Total turnover was 188,000 lats versus yesterday's 100,000 and the Rietumu Bank bourse index rose 2.27 percent to 227.58.
Unibanka rose to 4.75 lats from 4.64 lats after sliding most of last week following the cancellation of its merger with Zemes Banka. Dealers said that the shares may now move further up.
"The downward slide has been stopped and the share has stabilised," said one trader.
"It might go up by three to five percent each session," he added.
Unibanka accounted for the largest amount of today's trade with turnover at 44,000 lats.

Other official list shares Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) and Staburadze were also active, turning over 27,400 lats and 28,900 lats respectively. RTF gained one santime to 1.77 lats and Staburadze slipped to 2.86 lats from 2.88.
Dealers said the market in general should settle down after seeing some fluctuations of losses and gains recently.
"In general, this week we can expect still some fluctuations but less of a size," one dealer said.
On the secondary list, Kaija fish cannery accounted for most trade at 22,600 lats and it gained one santime to 2.38 lats.
Soft drinks maker Veldze climbed to 72 santimes from 63 santimes on turnover of 14,400 lats while Lode Brick turned over 13,200 lats and slipped to 2.60 lats from 2.86 lats.
